acceptance_conditions: NFT-ready media and metadata generation completes before any mint request
minting is optional and requires a separate confirmation showing wallet, network, and estimated fee
the sharing user receives the NFT and pays the minting fee only when minting is confirmed
declining or not confirming minting creates no mint fee and no blockchain effect
the first network is Solana devnet; mainnet is out of scope
the NFT is bound to one exact Knowledge Artifact Version
NFT possession or transfer grants no definition ownership, KEP co-ownership, copyright, license, publication right, or protocol authority
Definition NFT is a standalone optional representation Product attached to a completed KEP share. It neither changes KEP ownership nor grants rights to the definition.

At most one successful finalized mint per exact definition-version commitment within this Product on Solana devnet, across sharing users. A repeated request returns the existing result; another user cannot mint a second copy under this rule.

Never automatically create a replacement mint transaction. An uncertain outcome blocks another attempt until reconciliation proves no mint succeeded. A proven failed attempt requires a fresh user confirmation before retry. No burns, replacements or successor mints in v1.

Generate a deterministic SVG definition card and versioned JSON metadata from the exact version commitment and user-approved display fields. The default card shows only the version commitment. Never read or publish private definition content automatically. Store the exact bytes and their digests; content changes create a new representation.

Keep a content-addressed local review/export copy. Before minting, require an explicitly configured content-addressed retrieval location and a successful exact-byte readback of media and metadata. Promise verifiable bytes at confirmation, not permanent availability; show that limit to the user. Provider choice and deployment remain separate implementation work.

Authenticate the sharing Knowledge Identity separately, then require its intended receiving wallet to sign a one-use challenge bound to the identity, completed share, version, representation, devnet, intended mint attempt and expiry. The same wallet receives the NFT and pays the network fee. Wallet change or expired/reused challenge requires new verification.

Show the exact representation preview, receiving/paying wallet, network, fee estimate and permitted fee ceiling, and storage availability limit before a separate mint confirmation. Changed commitments, wallet or exceeded fee ceiling invalidate confirmation. Declining creates no transaction and no mint fee.
exclusions: automatic minting when the user requests only representation generation
charging a mint fee or submitting any blockchain transaction without a separate valid mint confirmation
minting to the KEP recipient; the selected recipient is the sharing user's confirmed wallet
treating a Solana wallet, public key, NFT owner, or fee payer as a KEP Knowledge Identity

treating NFT creation, possession, or transfer as Knowledge Co-Ownership, a Co-Ownership Grant, definition ownership, copyright, license, publication permission, governance authority, or proof that the represented definition is true or admitted
changing the exact definition version, propagation policy, KEP owner set, recipient access, or encryption material through NFT generation or minting
mainnet, production funds, production credentials, customer artifacts, publication, release, deployment, resale, royalties, marketplace behavior, or token-gated access
selecting an image generator, metadata standard, storage provider, wallet adapter, Solana token program, retry algorithm, or implementation architecture
claiming Product Capability adoption, business-ontology admission, DomainSpec construction, implementation, conformance, security review, operational readiness, or customer value
capability.outcome: For one exact definition-bearing Knowledge Artifact Version shared through KEP, let the sharing user optionally request one NFT-ready media-and-metadata representation bound to that exact version; after generation, let that same user either stop with no fee or blockchain effect, or separately confirm the receiving wallet, Solana devnet, exact commitments, and estimated fee before one mint attempt produces a correlated terminal receipt.
